# Mohammad Houda

> Software Engineer in Beirut building AI agents, enterprise integrations, and scalable backend systems with Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Next.js.

Portfolio and case studies at https://mohammadhouda.dev. Currently Solution Engineer at VAYACOM / DLVRD, building AI agents and conversational workflows for sales, support, and e-commerce clients.

## Projects

- [Raise](https://mohammadhouda.dev/projects/raise): Multi-tenant fundraising SaaS where startups run investor CRM, pipeline, commitments, and secure document sharing, with an AI copilot that cites its sources.
- [Distributed RAG Crawler](https://mohammadhouda.dev/projects/rag-crawler): Queue-based crawler and search engine splitting scraping, discovery, and indexing into independently scalable workloads, with hybrid retrieval.
- [DocAgent](https://mohammadhouda.dev/projects/doc-agent): AI query system over construction documents (BOQs, contracts, specs, schedules) that answers in plain language with every number grounded in SQL.
- [Hope Link](https://mohammadhouda.dev/projects/hopelink): Multi-portal platform connecting NGOs, charities, and volunteers across Lebanon, with a pre-computed opportunity ranking feed.
- [Shopify Checkout Automation](https://mohammadhouda.dev/projects/shopify-automation): End-to-end Shopify checkout automation in Puppeteer across two store flows.
- [Clinic Assistant](https://mohammadhouda.dev/projects/clinic-assistant): WhatsApp assistant for clinics that books appointments against real schedule data. In active development.

## Stack

Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis, BullMQ, Next.js, TypeScript, React, pgvector, RAG pipelines, AI agents.
